summary.text: Bill Wheat is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 37, representing Livingston, St. Tammany, Tangipahoa, according to the Senate member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.
The page lists Bill Wheat with committee assignments including Agriculture (Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The Senate member page lists Bill Wheat's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development (Vice Chair); Insurance; Revenue and Fiscal Affairs; Transportation, Highways and Public Works; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus; Northshore Delegation.
